newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 16.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ivory Coast's three mobile phone networks have a total of 15,000 subscribers five months after their service went on-line. The three suppliers are Comstar, Loteny Telecom and Ivoiris. LA VOIE - President of Abidjan's Abobo-Adjame University tells students boycotting classes over grants, assessment conditions and other grievances to return to classes before May 20 or the academic year will declared void. LE JOUR - Ivorian governement cedes management of Abidjan's Novotel Hotel to La Societe Hoteliere des Lagunes (SHL) in which the Accor pour l'Afrique group is the main shareholder; SHL signed a 10-year 1.75 billion CFA francs lease on the hotel and undertook to spend four billion CFA on renovations. ($=580 CFA francs) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
